title: Vehicle options and settings choices
summary: Reviews discuss the G60's range of options and settings, with praise for included features but criticism that the many choices can be hard to set up or navigate, while many excerpts are too fragmentary to classify clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle for offering strong feature content and appealing included options.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say the vehicle has too many options and that configuring some items is not easy.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention available options, lock-setting choices, setup behavior, or purchase options, but the snippets are too incomplete or ambiguous to assign a clear sentiment.
